stem: Which sentence supports the idea that goods were in demand during the Klondike gold rush?

options.label: A
options.text: They charged per mile and by weight when they helped carry supplies.

options.label: B
options.text: When she reached Dawson—the closest town to the goldfields—she sold these items for seven times the amount she purchased them for.

options.label: C
options.text: The men made their fortune collecting tolls from travelers.

options.label: D
options.text: It publicized Seattle as the "Gateway to the Golden Fields," hoping to bring the prospectors' business to Seattle.
